## 2026-07-26 - Backend Static Asset Caching
**Learning:** Returning users loading the frontend experienced unnecessary network latency because the backend did not cache hashed static assets generated by Vite.
**Action:** When serving Vite dist files via Express, use `express.static(path, { setHeaders: ... })` to apply aggressive caching (`public, max-age=31536000, immutable`) to hashed JS/CSS assets in `/assets/`, while explicitly setting `no-cache` for `.html` files to ensure seamless application updates.
